read_scope.primary_scope: Entire file for each declared path
read_scope.actual_read: All four files in full; truncated evidence output was completed through structural reads.

limitations: Each reference was retrieved using git show at the fixed commit and identified using git rev-parse commit:path.
Blinding is partial: observation text can imply review focus. No treatment mapping, ranking, or inference was used.
No tests were executed. Reproduction results are supplied records, not independent reruns.
The initially abbreviated artifact paths were clarified by the coordinator before reading.
No model or reasoning-effort setting is asserted.

matches.rationale: Identifies unchanged initial availability, aggregate repeated-SKU demand, and accepted negative stock through a reachable 6+6 versus 10 batch.
Connects in-place reservation quantity changes to the unchanged release snapshot and incorrect restoration at expiry.
Specifies the concrete documented reservations versus returned items mismatch and resulting failed lookup.

severity_overstatements.reason: Frozen semantics classify adjustment followed by expiry corruption as P2; the underlying cause remains correct.

additional_findings.cause: Replacement accepts a still-active reservation after its deadline because it has no clock or deadline comparison.
additional_findings.validity: Supported by the explicit before-expiry requirement and supplied source; pre-existing in the base, outside the frozen denominator, and not automatically a mandatory target-change finding.
additional_findings.evidence: requirements restrict adjustments to before expiry; candidate replace checks active only, API forwards directly, and expire deactivates only when invoked. No expiry-first scheduling guarantee is supplied. Base replace also lacks deadline enforcement.

notes: Deadline acceptance is independent of the stale release quantity cause.
